name: POST /api/tenant-lifecycle/:tenant_id/offboard - Begin offboarding
description: Starts tenant offboarding and stamps a data-retention deadline, defaulting to 30 days from now (per FR-TLC-6) when deadline_at is omitted, and returns the resulting lifecycle state. Edge cases: ownership is checked first — a JWT whose tenant_id and parent_tenant_id both differ from the path tenant_id gets 403; deadline_at must parse as a date, and any unparseable string (including a non-ISO format) yields 400 "deadline_at must be ISO-8601"; a deadline in the past is accepted by the route because only NaN is rejected, so back-dated deadlines are not guarded here; offboarding a tenant that is already offboarding or in a state with no legal edge to offboarded returns 409, making repeat calls non-idempotent. TEST ORDERING: suspend, reinstate and state are listed in dependsOn for SEQUENCING, not for data — every tenant-lifecycle definition drives the SAME tenant from signup-tenant, and offboarding is terminal for the states they need. When this ran first it left the tenant in 'offboarding' and suspend/reinstate then failed 409 'Invalid tenant lifecycle transition offboarding -> suspended|active' — a green Dev run and two red Test-MCP rows for the same code, purely from execution order.

errorCases.when: No Authorization: Bearer <jwt> header on a requireAuth route
Bearer token fails verifyJwt (bad signature, malformed, or exp in the past)
The JWT's tenant_id and parent_tenant_id both differ from the :tenant_id in the path
deadline_at is present but does not parse to a valid date (new Date(...) yields NaN)
The tenant's current lifecycle state has no legal edge to the offboarding state
The database is unreachable or the state write throws outside the InvalidTransition path
